simple.summary: מְרָתַיִם (Mᵉrâthayim) means Merathajim , an epithet of Babylon First listed occurrence: Jer 50 21.

definitions.full: H4850. Merathayim מְרָתַ֫יִם used as proper name, feminine = Babylon , מ ׳הָאָרֶץ עַלֿ עָלֶיהָ עֲלֵה Jer 50:21 ; perhaps = Double rebellion (dual) √ מרה q. v.; De Par 182 thinks = Babylonian Marrâtim , i.e., land by the nar Marrâtu, the bitter river (Persian Gulf) = Southern Babylonia.
